REGIME_1_PRE_COLLAPSE.description: Pre-dump equilibrium: prices near or above base, low recent volume, rising opponent inventory.

REGIME_2_ACTIVE_COLLAPSE.description: Post-dump collapse: market inventory saturated (I > I0), price falling rapidly.

REGIME_3_SHOP_DRAIN_SPIKE.description: Town shop drain tick (step % 4 == 0): town shops consume inventory, driving acute price spike.

REGIME_4_TERMINAL_PRE_EMPTION.description: Steps 690-694 terminal window: immediately before structural Step 695 opponent liquidation wave.

REGIME_5_TERMINAL_RECOVERY.description: Steps 704-706 and 716+: order book re-absorbs after first dump; secondary depth available.
